$comment: Dataset configuration for the BPI Challenge 2020 travel-expense event log.
This file is the ONLY place BPI-specific knowledge lives. Nothing in
src/erp_pipeline/ knows these column names, these process names or this
dataset. The demo script reads this file and hands it to the generic
process layer, which is the whole point: a different ERP event log is a
different configuration file, never a code change.
Column names below are the NORMALIZED names produced by generic CSV
ingestion, not the raw header. The raw headers follow the XES event-log
Dataset: https://data.4tu.nl/ (BPI Challenge 2020). Not redistributed here.
Additional keywords this dataset uses that the framework's generic ERP
vocabulary deliberately does not carry. 'declaration' is a plausible
generic term, but it is also this dataset's own vocabulary, so it is
supplied here rather than in the core defaults.
